relations: Celia（童年）；母亲（鸟类学家，揭示 Beatrice 身份）；Beatrice Donahue（《The Peacock Garden》作者，已故）
numbers: 《The Peacock Garden》1910 年重印；Eugenia 有多个哥哥（未给数）

facts.fact: Mixer 散场后 Celia 亲手清理，觉得客人驱散了「你」
facts.anchor: it felt like having them here had dispersed you
facts.verbatim: it felt like having them here had dispersed you

facts.fact: 母亲为她读馆藏《The Peacock Garden》（1910 年重印、原版雕版）
facts.anchor: a 1910 reprint featuring the original engravings
facts.verbatim: a 1910 reprint featuring the original engravings

facts.fact: 童话里 Eugenia 被锁大庄园、哥哥们被女巫变成孔雀，她收集羽毛缝衣、战女巫、乘孔雀车飞越树篱
母亲指着封面揭出：真名 Beatrice、用男名出版、曾住此、创办学院
facts.anchor: Her real name was Beatrice Donahue.
facts.verbatim: Her real name was Beatrice Donahue.

facts.fact: 童年 Celia 偷钥匙溜进故居，翻找台球只找到蛛网与陈年硬糖
facts.anchor: only spiderwebs and a dish of ancient hard candies
facts.verbatim: only spiderwebs and a dish of ancient hard candies

facts.fact: 二楼禁地藏着银茶具、人发假发、福尔马林里的整条眼镜蛇
她在主卧幻想 Beatrice 站在窗前，身后是墓地（她的长眠处）
facts.anchor: the obelisks and iron gates of the historic cemetery
facts.verbatim: the obelisks and iron gates of the historic cemetery

facts.fact: 结尾：她自认在用「你」的词召唤你的魂，而这正是你会写的故事
facts.anchor: I conjured your spirit in your house, with your words.
facts.verbatim: I conjured your spirit in your house, with your words.
